howWorks.heading: How CivicSetu Works
howWorks.subheading: Three transparent steps from discovery to application
howWorks.step1Desc: Answer a few basic questions about your state, age, and occupation. No Aadhaar or confidential data required.
howWorks.step2Desc: Our deterministic engine evaluates transparent rules and shows exact criteria satisfied, missed, or needing verification.
howWorks.step3Desc: Access verified document checklists, step-by-step instructions, and official government portal links.

why.heading: Why CivicSetu?
why.p1Desc: Find schemes that match your exact life situation without sifting through hundreds of government circulars.
why.p2Desc: Never wonder why you qualify or do not. We explain every condition clearly without black-box percentages.
why.p3Desc: Use the platform in English, Hindi, or Telugu to ensure accessibility for all family members.
why.p4Desc: Every scheme references official government departments, circulars, and direct application links.
